paras: Dixon's leaf-toed gecko (Phyllodactylus dixoni) is a species of lizard in the family Phyllodactylidae. The species is endemic to Venezuela.
The specific name, dixoni, is in honor of American herpetologist James R. Dixon.
The preferred natural habitat of Phyllodactylus dixoni is rocky areas, at an altitude of 40 m (130 ft).
